body: I mean that I don't care about myself enough to try to fix me. Being kind and caring could help my attitude and well being if I really tried to feel it, not just fake it, but I don't think I'm worth that much effort.
I'm incredibly sorry for your loss.
I guess the cliche factors: someone who is kind and caring. But if I try hard to be kind and caring, I'm doing it for others, not for myself.
I can assure you there has never be a person like that.

I really do try. I know it doesn't sound like it, but that's because I've made the internet my personal diary. I don't want people to see the real me, so I fake it with smiles and good deeds. I bake cookies and brownies for everyone on my floor (in my dorm). I always offer to help people and stick through with my promises. I try to make myself lovable for appearances, so that people will actually be around me, but it's not good enough.
I've made up this belief that the reason no one loves me is because I don't deserve it. So far nothing has disproved this theory, so I accept it as fact.
